description: Delete 404 monitor log entries: one entry by id, or every entry last seen within from..to (inclusive dates, either bound optional). With no argument the WHOLE log is cleared. Returns { deleted, success }.

from.description: Delete entries last seen on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

to.description: Delete entries last seen on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

name: seo_clear_monitor_log
